messages.subject: templated RNG in NUTS
parts:
I needed to get my hands on the seeded random
number generator (RNG) up in the command. So
I wanted to construct it there and pass it into
NUTS. So...

I added a template parameter to NUTS for the
base RNG. It defaults to the previous hard-wired
value:

template <typename RNG = boost::mt19937>
class nuts : public adaptive_sampler { ... };

I changed the constructor to take a base RNG
seeded with the time:

nuts(mcmc::prob_grad& model,
double delta = 0.6,
double epsilon = -1,
T base_rng = T(std::time(0)))

I use copy semantics for the RNG (well-defined for boost::random)
rather than a reference.

Thus the behavior won't change for clients that didn't set
a random number seed.

But we will need a template arg list, even if it's empty:

stan::mcmc::nuts<> sampler(model, 0.5, -1);

If we need a constructor with the
random-number seed, I can reinsert one.

- Bob
